profile.headline: Full Stack Developer || Technical Artist
profile.summary: Hey there! I'm a driven and versatile software engineering professional with experience in both front-end and back-end development. I'm skilled in a wide range of programming languages and frameworks, including TypeScript, ReactJS, NodeJS, ElectronJS, and more. As the Vice President of the UNC Asheville Chapter for the Association for Computing Machinery (ACM), I'm passionate about promoting computer science education and staying engaged with the latest developments in the field. As an Undergraduate Research Student, I've been developing streamlined terrain modeling that aggragates data from multiple public APIs to create visualizations and to process data for other applications.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Skills: React.js · Electron.js · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · C# · Avalonia · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Independent 3D Modeler & Software Developer
positions.description:
Research and development for mobile applications.
Responsible for the creation of 2D and 3D assets for projects and asset stores such as Sketchfab Store and Unity Assetstore.

positions.title: Course Ambassador for Multi-Variable Calculus
positions.description:
• Communicating with fellow course ambassadors and the professor to brainstorm techniques and strategies to provide a better experience for students.
• Identifying topics proving difficult for students to grasp and creating resources with LaTeX to compensate and improve their understanding of the material.
• Hosting study sessions with students outside of class hours to further their understanding in the material.

positions.title: Supplemental Instructor Leader for Precalculus & Single Variable Calculus (Mathematics)
positions.description:
• Identifying topics proving difficult for students to grasp and creating resources with LaTeX to assist with their understanding.
• Providing in-class assistance to the professor during practice work by steering students toward the correct train-of-thought and by affirming correct responses to improve confidence of the material.
• Hosting study sessions for students outside of class hours to further their understanding and confidence of the course material.
positions.insights: Skills: Precalculus · Mathematics · LaTeX · Teaching · Communication

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Skills: MATLAB · LaTeX · Data Modeling

positions.title: Computer Science Departmental Assistant
positions.description:
• Assist the department's administration assistant with social media content and event planning
• Assist as a web developer for the department's public facing website
• Assist as a System Administrator with Linux network, hardware, and computer lab configuration and troubleshooting

positions.title: Supplemental Instructor Leader for Single Variable Calculus (Mathematics)
positions.description:
• Identifying topics of single variable Calculus that are proving difficult for students to grasp and creating resources with LaTeX to assist them with their understanding.
• Communicating with fellow supplemental instructors and professors to brainstorm techniques and strategies to provide a better experience for students.
• Hosting study sessions with students outside of class hours to further their understanding in preparation for quizzes and exams.

positions.title: Information Technology Help Desk Technician
positions.description:
• Delivered comprehensive technical support to diverse clientele, including students, faculty, staff, and campus guests, addressing a wide range of IT issues such as WiFi connectivity, malware removal, classroom technology setups, learning management systems, and enterprise software troubleshooting.
• Collaborated with a team of technicians to manage and resolve hardware and software-related concerns, employing a proactive approach to problem-solving while maintaining a strong commitment to customer satisfaction.
• Collaborated with a select group of technicians to brainstorm and create articles to assist new students, staff, and faculty members with their initial onboarding experience in regards to technology.

positions.title: Computer Science: Undergraduate Research Student
positions.description:
• Developing software to cache satellite imagery and elevation data to minimize API usage costs from Google Maps and to provide a mouse-based editor for user-defined polygons to define areas of interest.
• Processing of discrete elevation points into a continuous surface to create topological maps with matplotlib.py.
• Developed functionality for data to be exported into accessible formats (png images & csv files) with preferences in mind for further analysis in a variety of other software.
• Porting of the project to an ElectronJS application to improve separation of model and view, improve the reactivity of the interface, and asynchronously distribute operations across multiple processes.

positions.title: Sales Floor Manager
positions.description:
• Coordinated with associates for workforce efficiency under payroll constraints for peak seasons (Christmas) and difficult times (COVID-19).
• Communicated between managers across the regional district for customer satisfaction and store stability.
• Developed automated workflows within Excel to predict hourly requirements for positions and departments.

positions.title: Backup Stockroom Manager / Cash Office Associate
3D Artist - Remote Consultant
positions.description:
• 3D-modeled game assets with Autodesk Maya and Blender3D from provided 2D concept art.
• Coordinated with the asset manager to minimize levels of crunch with the on-site asset production teams as the launch date drew closer.
• Utilized and developed small Python automations with Blender3D to speed up and provide better results.
positions.insights: Skills: 3D Modeling · UV Mapping · Substance Painter · Texture Painting

honors.title: Sketchfab Low Poly Challenge: Nonviolent Weapon - Winner
honors.description:
In this challenge, I was instructed to create a weapon that served a nonviolent purpose. With my intent, I wanted to create a weapon that shared face-value functionality and characteristics of real-life guns but with an appearance and usage of essentially a water gun. In the end, the concept turned into a flashy high powered bubble gun that has seen some usage. You can find more details about the piece and view in 3D in this article:

https://sketchfab.com/blogs/community/sketchfab-low-poly-challenge-non-violent-weapon/

honors.title: Dean's List from Fall 2021 to Spring 2026
honors.description: Finished each semester with a GPA of 3.5 or above while enrolled as a full-time student.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of North Carolina at Asheville
